cases.name: Astraia Marie Pulliam Muir
cases.narrative: Due to the extent of her injuries, a visual positive identification could not be determined and identification had to be made by means of fingerprint results. She had multiple lacerations to face and torso. He was found hanging nearby in the closet, police reported. He had superficial lacerations to his wrists. Located on the bed was her 7-month-old son, who was physically unharmed.
